heading: Rigorous enough for science. Practical enough for the business.
description: Every engagement begins with the decision your team needs to make—not a predefined deliverable. The work then moves through four disciplined stages.

steps.title: Frame
steps.description: Define the decision, stakeholders, evidence base, constraints and success criteria.

steps.title: Interrogate
steps.description: Test assumptions against data, field intelligence and the clinical context.

steps.title: Align
steps.description: Create shared priorities, roles and a realistic path across functions.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.description: Execute the work, capture learning and leave the team with usable tools.
